messages:
emma (AM): heads-up — AcmeHealth legal sent a list: they want SOC 2 artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, and temporary network scan access to our POC env. asking if we can provide IP allowlist or a short-lived bastion.
sofia (Sales Eng): thanks. do they need full Type II or redacted artifacts? also any constraints on encryption headers/KMS attestation?
emma (AM): they said 'SOC 2 report + control mappings (redacted ok)'. KMS attestation: confirmation we use customer-key isolation for Dedicated or a description of key mgmt for hosted.
ramon (Security): we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and a Controls Matrix export. for pen-test letter we need to know scope (IPs, time window, testing types). we sign a letter-of-attestation that lists permitted testing windows and contact POC.
zoe (EngOps): for scans we can't give public creds. options: (1) short-lived bastion jumpbox + named user + ephemeral key, (2) allowlist static scanner IPs into the POC subnet, or (3) provide read-only SFTP with exported logs if they only need artifacts. which does customer prefer?
emma (AM): they prefer IP allowlist but can do bastion if needed. they asked about TLS headers/encryption proof for data-in-transit and KMS key origin (AWS KMS vs customer-managed).
ramon (Security): short answers — TLS is TLS 1.2+ with recent ciphers, we can provide cipher list. KMS: hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS (we can provide a diagram + attestation). Dedicated can use customer KMS via BYOK (we provide config steps).
sofia (Sales Eng): can you paste a minimal pen-test letter template I can send to their legal? they need a signed doc from us confirming permitted tests and contact details.
ramon (Security): sure — use this as starter and I will sign.
ramon (Security): ```
Penetration Test Acknowledgement
Company: Redwood Inference Inc.
Date: <date>
Scope: Authorized testing limited to <IP range or hostnames> during <window>.
Allowed testing: external network, application layer testing (no social engineering, no physical).
Restrictions: no SIM swap, no denial-of-service or sustained brute force.
POC Contact: security@redwood.com, +1-555-0100.
Signature: Ramon Alvarez, Head of Security
```
zoe (EngOps): for allowlist, send me the scanner IPs and desired CIDR. we'll open ports 22/443 and monitor. note: scans that create high connection rates will be throttled by infra.
emma (AM): customer sent this: "scanner will run out-of-hours, not more than 1000 conn/min, target range 10.23.40.0/24". they also want the SOC2 redacted file and Controls Matrix link.
ramon (Security): OK i'll drop redacted SOC2 + matrix to secure drive and share link. i'll also prepare the signed pen-test letter as a PDF.
sofia (Sales Eng): can we give timeline? Acme legal asked for artifacts by Thursday EOD.
zoe (EngOps): allowlist change + monitoring we can do same-day if we have the CIDR and contact for blast tests. provisioning bastion would take ~24 hours.
ramon (Security): I'll upload SOC2 redacted + matrix by 2390024725 and email signed pen-test letter by 2390024755. tagging @sre-bot to create the temp monitoring ticket. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Created ticket INFRA-5421 for scan monitoring and allowlist change. ETA 4 hours.
emma (AM): perfect — I'll message the customer with the plan: redacted SOC2 + matrix link, signed pen-test letter, and confirm allowlist changes. thanks all. :pray:
sofia (Sales Eng): sending now. will include this snippet for KMS answer: "Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (attestation provided). Dedicated: supports BYOK integrations with customer KMS; we'll share config docs."
ramon (Security): ping me if legal asks for additional wording.
zoe (EngOps): noted — will watch INFRA-5421 and confirm once allowlist live.
emma (AM): closing loop here — customer acknowledged and scheduled test window for Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC.
sofia (Sales Eng): nice. win for the deal. :tada:
